## What's new

**Auto switch status is now Status suggestions.** The plugin never changes your status by itself anymore. When you join or leave a call, a notification suggests the status you picked, and your status changes only if you click it. It still waits 10 seconds after the last move, so hopping between rooms gives one suggestion, and it only asks when your status is different.

**The button is hidden by default.** Press **Shift + F12** to open Friends in Voice (press again to close). The button also shows for 5 seconds. To keep it visible, turn off *Keep the Friends in Voice button hidden* in the settings.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.20.2.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
